content.short: Polyzoa is an anti-scam security layer embedded in blockchain infrastructure.
content.description: Polyzoa relies on a dynamic threat detection technology instead of traditional static blacklists and manual investigations. By analyzing patterns in real time, it identifies 85% of previously unseen phishing scams and blocks signed phishing transactions before they reach users. The approach is non-intrusive to end users, hassle-free for Web3 projects, and delivers meaningful benefits to infrastructure providers responsible for securing networks and applications.
